headline: Carrier Announces Agreement to Sell NORESCO to OPTERRA Energy Services
summary: Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR), global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its NORESCO business to OPTERRA Energy Services, a subsidiary of LS Power. The transaction is expected to close shortly.

headline: JD.com signs home comfort retail agreement with Carrier
summary: As part of the arrangement, Carrier’s brands will deepen their existing relationship with JD.com by combining the retailer’s online commerce infrastructure with its physical store network.
